policy: Records substantive clinical-content, safety, and governance changes. Cosmetic-only changes are omitted.

entries.title: Focused outpatient calculator expansion
entries.summary: Added six frequently used outpatient calculations with source-linked limitations and reorganized navigation around the site owner's clinical workflow.
entries.scope: Adult anthropometrics, smoking exposure and LDCT criteria, A1C/eAG conversion, blood-pressure averaging, AHA PREVENT risk, and orthostatic vitals
changes: Added adult BMI category, Mosteller BSA, Devine ideal body weight, and medication-specific adjusted body-weight context.
Added pack-year calculation and a bounded check of USPSTF age, exposure, and smoking-timing criteria for annual low-dose CT.
Added bidirectional A1C and estimated-average-glucose conversion using the ADAG relationship.
Added averaging for up to six complete blood-pressure readings with 2025 AHA/ACC category context.
Added the published race-free AHA PREVENT base equations for 10-year total CVD and ASCVD risk, without optional UACR, A1C, or SDI predictors.
Added supine-to-standing BP and heart-rate deltas with the AHA orthostatic-hypotension definition and timing safeguard.
Kept Accutane Dosing first by owner preference and reordered the remaining category groups for common outpatient use.
Marked the calculator collection for renewed clinician review.

entries.title: Claim-level clinical surveillance and independent review
entries.summary: Expanded clinical monitoring from tool-level source discovery to mapped content-area traceability, urgent official alerts, stable-document fingerprints, and evidence-based two-stage review.
entries.scope: Clinical governance, monitoring, and review operations
changes: Mapped 26 clinically actionable content areas to approved authoritative sources and added governance gates for every monitored and high-risk tool.
Added daily FDA MedWatch and CDC Health Alert Network surveillance without permitting automatic clinical-content edits.
Added weekly SHA-256 fingerprints for designated stable FDA, KDIGO, and ACEP/ENA source documents.
Added a dedicated monthly Empiric Therapy literature monitor.
Added durable focused review packets containing exact detected publications, official-alert links, page-version changes, or bounded source-document text diffs.

Limited routine review confirmation to the claims and sources connected to each retained event while preserving broad scheduled reviews and honestly labeling legacy detections whose details were not retained.
Expanded the review portal to record content areas, source versions, limitations, change references, review due dates, and durable audit evidence.
Required critical content areas to remain pending until a different authenticated reviewer completes an independent review.

entries.title: Asthma Control Test score interpretation
entries.summary: Added a license-conscious ACT score calculator that accepts item scores from the authorized form without reproducing the copyrighted questionnaire.
entries.scope: ACT total and published control threshold for patients age 12 and older
changes: Added five constrained 1–5 item-score inputs and automatic total calculation from 5 to 25.
Displays the published well-controlled, not-well-controlled, and very-poorly-controlled cut points with a three-point minimal-important-difference note.
Links to the existing publisher-attributed ACT PDF and intentionally does not reproduce questionnaire wording.
Keeps treatment decisions outside the score and marks the calculator collection for clinician review.

entries.title: Focused renal, cardiac, hepatic, and metabolic calculations
entries.summary: Expanded the calculator workspace with source-limited risk estimates and laboratory context while keeping related assessments within their existing clinical workflows.
entries.scope: KFRE, QTc, hyperglycemia laboratory context, HAS-BLED, and Child-Pugh
changes: Integrated the North American four-variable KFRE into CKD G/A staging for the validated adult CKD G3–G5 population.
Added Fridericia- and Bazett-corrected QT intervals with rate and tracing limitations.
Added corrected sodium, effective and total calculated osmolality, and optional anion gap without presenting the results as a DKA/HHS diagnosis.
Integrated HAS-BLED into CHA2DS2-VASc with an explicit warning not to use bleeding scores alone to withhold anticoagulation.
Integrated Child-Pugh into MELD with visible subjective ascites and encephalopathy inputs.
Linked government-hosted STOP-BANG and Epworth Sleepiness Scale PDFs without copying the instruments into the repository.
Marked the calculator collection for clinician review before its pending state can be cleared.

entries.title: Adult urgency and disposition support
entries.summary: Added a conservative clinician-facing workflow for recognizing adult emergency threats, physiologic concern, complaint red flags, and factors that lower the threshold for escalation.
entries.scope: Adult acute-care escalation and safety-net documentation
changes: Added immediate-threat and complaint-specific red-flag screening that overrides lower-acuity pathways.
Added adult vital-sign context using NEWS2 Scale 1 single-parameter score-3 boundaries as escalation prompts rather than a diagnosis or disposition rule, with an explicit Scale 2 limitation.
Required complete vital signs and three explicit safety confirmations before displaying a lower-acuity pathway.
Added copyable documentation, monthly surveillance, authoritative source links, and a mandatory pending clinician-review state.
Did not reproduce ESI levels, diagnose conditions, provide pediatric triage, or declare home care safe.

entries.title: Authenticated clinical review workflow
entries.summary: Added a private, audited workflow for completing source-based clinician reviews without server-shell access.
changes: Added an Authelia-protected review queue showing monitored topics, current state, and approved authoritative sources.
Required authenticated identity, source selection, a documented clinical decision, clinician attestation, and stale-state protection for every acknowledgement.
Added a sandboxed loopback service and append-only operational audit record without exposing command execution or general file editing.

entries.title: HCPCS Level II terminology search
entries.summary: Added live official HCPCS Level II search while preserving the licensing boundary around the AMA CPT code set.
changes: Added current CMS HCPCS Level II services and supplies through the NLM Clinical Tables API, excluding terminated codes.
Clearly distinguished HCPCS Level II from CPT and did not reproduce unlicensed CPT codes or descriptions.

entries.title: Focused primary-care tools and safety controls
entries.summary: Added focused screening and decision-support workflows, strengthened document-grounded assistant safeguards, and increased surveillance for high-risk tools.
entries.scope: Calculators, antimicrobial stewardship, HIV prevention, assistant safety, and governance
changes: Added FIB-4, CKD G/A staging, AUDIT-C, and a validated single-question drug-use screen with interpretation limits.
Integrated McIsaac testing support into GAS pharyngitis without recommending score-based empiric antibiotics.
Added a narrow CDC-based PrEP/PEP workflow to the STI guide.
Added an identifier-removal gate, server-side identifier screening, retrieval-confidence refusal, citation enforcement, and citation dates to the Clinical Assistant.
Added monthly surveillance for curated high-risk tools and an append-only, root-only human review audit trail.
Deferred STOP-BANG because the authoritative questionnaire repository requires reuse permission.

entries.title: Clearer tool names and connected stewardship workflows
entries.summary: Clarified the scope of two live-data searches and connected four complementary antimicrobial tools without merging their distinct workflows.
changes: Renamed Drug Reference to FDA Label Search so the tool is not mistaken for a curated prescribing reference.
Renamed Drug Lookup to Code & Terminology Lookup to reflect its ICD-10-CM, RxTerms, and LOINC datasets.
Added a shared stewardship navigator linking guideline regimens, empiric therapy with local susceptibility, local antibiograms, and allergy cross-reactivity.
Kept each tool's source context and clinical workflow separate.

entries.title: Clinical monitoring reliability
entries.summary: Expanded the safeguards around scheduled source monitoring and automated clinical data updates.
changes: Added shared failure alerts for every scheduled monitoring and update service.
Added a weekly availability check for the authoritative sources in the clinical review registry.
Documented review ownership, source mappings, and the distinction between monitoring and clinician review.
Added independently reviewable regression vectors for high-risk calculations and dosing boundaries.

entries.title: Clinical guidance and safety review
entries.summary: Reviewed and updated selected high-risk guidance against current primary and authoritative sources.
changes: Aligned adult and pediatric resuscitation references with the current AHA guideline editions.
Updated sepsis, glucocorticoid, STI, immunization, anticoagulation, opioid, and toxicology safety content where newer authoritative guidance applied.
Added explicit review status and source mappings without claiming independent clinical validation.
Preserved existing calculations and added regression coverage for critical formula and dosing behavior.

entries.title: Unified clinical interface rollout
entries.summary: Brought the clinical tools into one responsive, accessible visual system while preserving tool-specific workflows.
changes: Introduced shared design tokens, application headers, theme controls, footers, and reusable clinical components.
Improved phone and tablet layouts, keyboard focus, touch targets, contrast, and dark mode.
Retained clinically meaningful colors and the existing calculation and interaction logic.
Removed obsolete V2 routes after the redesigned pages replaced them.
